name: Crazy Eights
tagline: Match suit or rank, eights are wild. First to empty their hand wins.

options.label: Q skips, A reverses, 2 draws two

rulesSummary: Be first to play out your hand. Five cards each (seven with two players); one card turned up starts the pile.
On your turn, play a card matching the rank or suit of the top card, or draw one card, which ends your turn. You may draw even if you could play.
An 8 goes on anything: call the suit the next player must follow (or they play another 8). A turned-up 8 lets the dealer call the suit.

Specials (a lobby option, on unless changed): Q skips the next player, A reverses direction, 2 makes the next player draw two unless they play a 2, which passes on the lot (an 8 can't). They count when turned up too.
Last card (a lobby option): when you go down to one card, tap Last card! before the next player moves, or draw two.
When the stock runs out, the pile (except its top card) is shuffled into a new one. If nobody can play or draw, the hand ends.
Everyone but the winner scores the cards they hold: 8s 50, pictures 10, others their number (ace 1). When someone reaches the target, the lowest score wins.
With two players, a Q gives you another turn and an A does nothing.
Six or more players: two decks shuffled together.
